pr_body:
Prior to this change NodeReplacementAllocationDecider was unconditionally
skipping both replacement source and target nodes when calculation auto-expand
replicas. This is fixed by autoexpanding to the replacement node if source node
already had shards of the index.

Closes: #89527
pr_comment: Hi @idegtiarenko, I've created a changelog YAML for you.
Added the `v7.17.13` label because this has now been backported /cc @kingherc

review_comment: Can we add a verification that a shard that is not yet on the source node cannot expand to the target node?

Do you mean that shard from any other node of the cluster cannot auto-expand to the replacement target node?
I believe it can according to the `NodeShutdownAllocationDecider`

The `NodeReplacementAllocationDecider` should reject this here:

https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/96281/files#diff-6c6bb87a8918c913f92d49ba4c9dc5973f35052f062afe45706dc3a0011b324eR153

for the case where the shard is not yet present on the node.
I did not find this comment addressed?

This scenario:
* put a shard on the node_c
* replace node_a -> node_b
* check shard from the node_c is not auto-expanding replicas to node_a or node_b

is verified in `org.elasticsearch.cluster.routing.allocation.decider.NodeReplacementAllocationDeciderTests#testShouldNotAutoExpandReplicasDuringUnrelatedNodeReplacement`, unless I miss something
Thanks for pointing me to it.
Can we add a verification that a shard that is not yet on the source node cannot expand to it?
I did not find this comment addressed?

NodeShutdownAllocationDeciderTests only prevents allocations and auto expands on the node that is about to be shut down and do not restrict allocations on the replacement node.

A scenario `shard from any node in cluster can not be auto-expanded on removing node` is tested in: `testCannotAutoExpandToRemovingNode`
A similar one for replacing node is tested in: testAutoExpandDuringNodeReplacement. Please note no ShardRouting created as both tests do not depend on the source shard location (from NodeShutdownAllocationDecider point of view).
Sorry for the confusion, I meant this for the replace decider. See [this comment](https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/96281/files#r1219134129).
